info.title: Checkout & Rewards
info.description:
Backend for a small store: carts, idempotent checkout, and a rewards program that issues a
discount coupon after every *n*-th successfully placed order.

## Conventions
- **Money is an integer in the currency's minor unit** in every field named `*_minor`, with the ISO 4217
  code in a `currency` field next to it: `{"price_minor": 8999, "currency": "INR"}` is ₹89.99. The minor unit is
  paise for INR, cents for USD and yen for JPY (no decimals). There are no floats anywhere.
- **One currency per store**, set with the `CURRENCY` setting. Each order keeps the currency it was
  placed in, so changing the setting later never re-labels past orders.
- **Every error has the same shape.** Branch on `error.code`, not on `message` or the HTTP status alone:
  ```json
  {"error": {"code": "INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY", "message": "...", "details": {...}}}
  ```
  - `404`: the resource in the path doesn't exist.
  - `409`: the request is valid but conflicts with current state. Retrying won't help until the state changes.
  - `422`: the request itself is wrong.
- **Request bodies reject unknown fields**, so `{"coupon": "..."}` (a typo for `coupon_code`)
  fails loudly instead of silently checking out at full price.

## Retries and concurrency
- **Checkout is idempotent per cart.** Retrying `POST /carts/{cart_id}/checkout` with the same body returns
  the original order (`200`) instead of creating a second one (`201` the first time). A cart becomes at most one order.
- `PUT` and `DELETE` on cart items are safe to retry. `POST /carts/{cart_id}/items` returns
  `409 ITEM_ALREADY_IN_CART` on a retry rather than doubling the quantity.
- Concurrent checkouts **never oversell** and a coupon is **never redeemed twice**. A checkout that fails
  changes nothing: no stock is taken and the coupon stays available.

## Prices
Carts always show **current** prices. The price is fixed at checkout, and the order keeps its own copy, so later
product changes never alter a placed order. Send `expected_total_minor` at checkout to refuse a total
the customer hasn't seen.

## Administration
Operations under `/admin` are administrative. Authentication is out of scope for this exercise;
in production they would require an admin role.

200.description: All products with current price and stock.

post.description: Creates an empty cart. Not idempotent, but a duplicate just leaves an unused empty cart behind.

get.description:
Lines show the current unit price, current stock and an `in_stock` flag, so a UI can warn before
checkout. Prices aren't locked in until checkout.

200.description: The cart, priced at **current** product prices.

out_of_stock.summary: Stock dropped after the item was added

post.description:
Adds a product that isn't in the cart yet. If it's already there, this returns `409 ITEM_ALREADY_IN_CART`
instead of adding more, so a retried request can't double the quantity. Use `PUT` to change a quantity.

The stock check here is advisory: carts don't reserve stock, and checkout re-checks it.

ITEM_ALREADY_IN_CART.summary: Product already in the cart (use PUT)

error.message: Product already in cart; use PUT to change its quantity

INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY_ADD.summary: More than is in stock right now

error.message: Not enough inventory for requested quantity
Cart has already been checked out

put.description: Sets the quantity, adding the item if it isn't in the cart yet. Safe to retry.

INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY_ADD.summary: More than is in stock right now

error.message: Not enough inventory for requested quantity
Cart has already been checked out

delete.description: Removes the item. Removing an item that isn't in the cart also returns `200`, so retries are safe.

error.message: Cart has already been checked out

post.description:
Validates the cart and places the order in a single transaction. Either all of it happens
(order created, stock taken, coupon redeemed) or none of it does.

- **Idempotent per cart:** retrying with the same `coupon_code` returns the original order with `200`.
  A retry with a *different* coupon is a new request and gets `409 CART_ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT`.
- **All or nothing:** if any line is short on stock, the whole checkout fails and nothing changes.
- **Concurrency:** concurrent checkouts never oversell, and a coupon is redeemed by exactly one of them.
- **Prices** are taken at this moment and copied into the order.

guarded.description: The client showed the customer ₹98.97 (9897 paise). If prices moved since, checkout is refused.

200.description: Retry of a checkout that already succeeded: the **original** order is returned and nothing is charged again.

CART_CHECKED_OUT_DIFFERENT_COUPON.summary: Cart already placed with a different coupon

error.message: Cart was already checked out with a different coupon
Not enough inventory for one or more items

COUPON_ALREADY_REDEEMED.summary: Coupon already used by another order

error.message: Order total differs from what the client expected
Cannot check out an empty cart

get.description:
Orders never change after they're placed. Names and prices are copies from checkout time,
so they still explain the total after the catalogue changes.

schema.title: Response List Coupons Admin Coupons Get

post.description:
Issues **one** coupon for the oldest milestone that has been reached but not rewarded yet.
With n = 5, milestones fall at orders 5, 10, 15, and so on; every placed order counts, including discounted ones.
If several milestones are owed, call again for each. Concurrent calls can never issue two coupons for the same milestone.

The coupon gets the current x%, which stays fixed even if the configuration changes later. After a change to n,
the next milestone is `last rewarded + n`.

201.description: Coupon issued for the oldest unrewarded milestone.

error.message: No unrewarded order milestone has been reached

get.description:
Read-only, so repeated calls never change state. All figures come from one database snapshot, so they always agree:
`net = gross − discounts = Σ order totals` and `coupons.generated = available + redeemed`.

200.description: Totals derived from placed orders and coupons.

patch.summary: Change a product's price or stock
patch.description:
Use this to see what happens when the catalogue changes under an open cart. Open carts
show the new price immediately. Placed orders keep the price they were charged.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: ID of an existing product, e.g. `p_keyboard`.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Whole units, 1–1000. Must be a JSON integer: `1.5` and `"2"` are rejected.

order_id.title: Order Id
order_id.description: The order this cart became, once checked out.

subtotal_minor.title: Subtotal Minor
subtotal_minor.description: Sum of line totals at current prices, before any coupon.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code all amounts on this object are in, e.g. `INR`. Amounts are integers in its minor unit: paise for INR, cents for USD, yen for JPY.

unit_price_minor.title: Unit Price Minor
unit_price_minor.description: The product's **current** price; not locked in until checkout.

available_inventory.title: Available Inventory
available_inventory.description: Current stock. Carts don't reserve stock.

coupon_code.title: Coupon Code
coupon_code.description: Optional coupon from `POST /admin/coupons`. Unknown or used codes fail the checkout.

expected_total_minor.title: Expected Total Minor
expected_total_minor.description: Optional. The total the client showed the customer. If the real total differs (price changed, coupon changed), checkout fails with `409 TOTAL_CHANGED` and nothing is written.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: Discount this coupon gives. Fixed when issued; later config changes don't affect it.

milestone_order.title: Milestone Order
milestone_order.description: The order count that earned this coupon, e.g. 5, 10, 15.

redeemed_order_id.title: Redeemed Order Id
redeemed_order_id.description: The order that used this coupon, if any.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Branch on this, not on `message`.

details.title: Details
details.description: Structured data the client can act on; `{}` when there is none.

discount_percent.title: Discount Percent
discount_percent.description: Taken from the coupon when it was issued; 0 without a coupon.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code the order was priced in, copied at checkout. It never changes, even if the store's currency does.

product_name.title: Product Name
product_name.description: Snapshot of the product name at checkout.

unit_price_minor.title: Unit Price Minor
unit_price_minor.description: Snapshot of the price charged at checkout.

price_minor.title: Price Minor
price_minor.description: Current unit price in minor units.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code all amounts on this object are in, e.g. `INR`. Amounts are integers in its minor unit: paise for INR, cents for USD, yen for JPY.

price_minor.title: Price Minor
price_minor.description: New unit price in minor units. Omit to keep.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: New absolute stock level. Omit to keep.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: One entry per currency that orders were placed in. Normally a single entry; more only if the store's currency was changed. Amounts in different currencies are never added together.

gross_revenue_minor.title: Gross Revenue Minor
gross_revenue_minor.description: Sum of order subtotals in this currency (before discounts).

discounts_minor.title: Discounts Minor
discounts_minor.description: Sum of order discounts in this currency.

net_revenue_minor.title: Net Revenue Minor
net_revenue_minor.description: `gross − discounts`, equal to the sum of order totals in this currency.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Whole units, 1–1000. Must be a JSON integer: `1.5` and `"2"` are rejected.
